message: マリア様が見まくってる
After a fierce battle, we somehow managed to win.
Being able to defeat him without fully awakening the Demon Lord's power was undoubtedly thanks to my solid teamwork with Misa.
However, it seemed my opponent had seen right through me.

name: Ardin
message: 「Y-You... If you're actually the Demon Lord, you should've said so from the start...」

name: Ardin
message: 「Dammit! First Virus, and now the Demon Lord--what kind of insane power is this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Virus? You know him?!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Know him? He's my rival in love! We just fought a little while ago.」

name: Ardin
message: 「A-And then... I lost in such a pathetic way... And worse yet, Pasta-chan saw the whole thing...」

name: Ardin
message: 「After exposing a shameful side like that, I don't even qualify as a rival in love anymore! Waaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is Virus really that strong?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Yeah, he's crazy strong!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Thing is, up until just recently, even though he was strong, you could still see the limit of his power. Then all of a sudden, he turned into a total monster.」

name: Ardin
message: 「Something's off about that bastard. Even when he's just standing still, he gives off this massive intimidating aura.」

name: Ardin
message: 「And he glares at me with eyes looking down on me even more than before...!」

name: Ardin
message: 「It pissed me off so much I tried to punch him, and with just a single fingertip... Gwooooh~」

name: Synn
message: 「So he beat you effortlessly.」

name: Ardin
message: 「I'm totally finished! I can't ever show my face to Pasta-chan again!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not pathetic at all. You're just a little clumsy, Ardin.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the exact same way.」

name: Ardin
message: 「Y-You are? Even though you're the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I don't know how to convey my feelings of 'love'...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I end up trying to show off my strong side, or giving gifts before I can actually express how I feel.」

name: Ardin
message: 「Y-You actually understand me?!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Demon Lord! You're a great guy!! Call me anytime if something happens--I'll come running right away!!」
Ardin joined the party.

name: Ardin
message: 「See ya. Catch you later」
